news.title: Telangana assembly okays CURE Bill, caps revision of property tax at 10%
news.para: On Saturday, the Core Urban Region Bill was passed by the Telangana assembly, significantly cutting the property tax revision limit from twenty percent to ten. The BJP opposed this legislation and sought its retraction, whereas AIMIM requested the bill's referral to a select committee. Conversely, the CPI party expressed their support for the bill proposed by the legislative affairs minister.

news.title: Six lakh property owners yet to pay ₹848 crore tax in Chennai
news.para: Greater Chennai Corporation has urged over six lakh property owners to clear their tax dues.  The civic body is awaiting ₹847.80 crore in pending property tax collections.  Property tax funds essential civic services like roads and public health initiatives.  Owners must pay property tax every half-yearly period before the deadline.  Failure to pay will attract interest on outstanding amounts from the next period.

news.title: Odisha RERA mandates buyer-promoter presence at CDR hearings
news.para: The Odisha Real Estate Regulatory Authority has mandated that parties attend conciliation hearings in person. This new rule is designed to enhance the effectiveness of dispute resolution and minimize delays. Both promoters and complainants are expected to be present to foster meaningful discussions and arrive at decisions. The conciliation cell strives to facilitate amicable resolutions between homebuyers and developers, ensuring that proceedings conclude promptly without unwarranted postponements.

news.title: Prayagraj development body plans ‘Tulsi Vihar’ housing scheme on reclaimed Kareli land
news.para: The Prayagraj Development Authority is set to breathe new life into the encroached lands with the launch of 'Tulsi Vihar', a residential project that aims to restore the historical essence of the Tulsipur area. Alongside this, potential homeowners can take advantage of enticing discounts on more than 400 available flats, enjoying waivers and early payment bonuses of up to eighteen percent. Allotments will be prioritized on a first-come, first-served basis.

news.title: Not a brick has moved in 21 months: Supertech buyers hit the streets, say will march to Parliament next
news.para: Homebuyers of Supertech's halted projects are voicing their frustration over construction delays. They are insisting on an immediate revival of work along with definitive completion timelines. Although NBCC was designated as the project management consultant more than twenty-one months ago, no significant construction progress has occurred, despite repeated court orders, leaving buyers disheartened and anxious.

news.title: Panchkula civic body seals six buildings without approved maps
news.para: In a bid to uphold building regulations, the Panchkula Municipal Corporation has sealed six buildings found to be constructed without sanctioned plans. Following thorough inspections, civic officials identified multiple violations of municipal laws. MC commissioner Vinay Kumar underscored the importance of systematic urban development, asserting that efforts will be made to ensure compliance and deter unauthorized construction with ongoing inspections and enforcement actions.

news.title: Ahmedabad civic body offers nine plots worth ₹1,010 crore with FSI, height details
news.para: The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation has announced an auction for nine city plots, each featuring distinct development criteria. With a combined base price exceeding one thousand crore rupees, these plots present a lucrative opportunity for developers. Interested parties are encouraged to gauge their potential as they prepare to submit bids during this multi-day online auction process, designed to enhance builder engagement and facilitate urban growth.

news.title: April–Aug property registrations in Maharashtra jump 12% over last year, revenue up nearly 16%
news.para: In the first five months of the 2026-27 fiscal year, Maharashtra's property registrations saw a significant increase of 12.4%. The region's revenue collections experienced an impressive rise of nearly 16%, reaching Rs 26,637.73 crore. Steady transaction activity, particularly high-value deals, has fueled this growth. As the festive season approaches, officials anticipate that this positive momentum will further invigorate the property market.

news.title: Delhi LG approves health scheme for registered construction workers
news.para: The Lieutenant Governor of Delhi has sanctioned an innovative health scheme aimed at benefiting registered construction workers. This initiative provides annual health check-ups along with cashless outpatient services for the workers and their eligible spouses. Coverage for treatments can reach up to two lakh rupees for each beneficiary annually, and the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will oversee this significant program.

news.title: Nanded civic body collects ₹5 crore property tax in National Lok Adalat
news.para: The Nanded-Waghala City Municipal Corporation successfully gathered over five crore rupees in property tax during the National Lok Adalat held on Saturday. A remarkable 3,218 property owners took the opportunity to settle their outstanding dues, enjoying an eighty percent waiver on penalties associated with their tax arrears. Residents are reminded to pay any remaining balances promptly to prevent potential coercive measures.

news.title: Patna civic body widens tax net, adds 4,771 new properties this fiscal
news.para: In the current financial year, Patna Municipal Corporation has successfully included 4,771 additional properties in its tax registry. Over 66% of these property owners promptly paid their taxes after performing self-assessments. Additionally, the corporation has reassessed 4,911 properties due to updated information. Surveys revealed discrepancies in 137 properties, resulting in penalties and further evaluations. To enhance revenue, a focused campaign is being implemented across all six circles.

news.title: Prayagraj civic body caps property mutation delay fee at ₹1,000
news.para: Prayagraj Municipal Corporation has capped the building mutation delay fee at just Rs 1,000, providing essential support to around twenty thousand property owners in the city. Additionally, the corporation intends to abolish compound interest on overdue property taxes, introducing a scheme where defaulters will only owe twelve percent interest on pending amounts. This initiative greatly alleviates the financial burden on property tax defaulters.

news.title: Nashik civic body to hold ward camps to bring 20,000 properties under tax net
news.para: Nashik Municipal Corporation will begin hosting targeted camps across various wards in October. These efforts are aimed at locating and evaluating unassessed properties, with expectations of including around twenty thousand new entries into the tax register. The initiative anticipates an additional fifteen crore rupees in annual income, as the corporation aims for a more robust property tax collection by 2026-27.

news.title: Major relief for plot holders in Haryana as HSVP launches scheme to settle dues
news.para: Haryana Shehri Vikas Pradhikaran has launched the Vivadon Se Samadhan Scheme 2026, presenting plot holders with a valuable opportunity to settle. This initiative aims to relieve over Rs 724 crore and will aid around 4,414 allottees from ten states. It encompasses residential, institutional, group housing, and industrial plots. Allottees are required to clear their dues by December 31, 2026, to avoid plot resumption.

news.title: Ahmedabad civic body, Auda fail to enforce structural stability certificate rule
news.para: Authorities in Ahmedabad are overlooking a significant requirement concerning older buildings, specifically the need for structural stability certificates for those over fifteen years old. While the state approved this regulation back in 2014, it has not been enforced. Insufficient staffing has been identified as a primary reason for the ongoing failure to implement this vital safety measure effectively.

news.title: Chennai metro rail plans seven-storey commercial complex at Arumbakkam
news.para: Chennai Metro Rail Limited is planning to build a seven-storey commercial complex near the Arumbakkam station. This new standalone structure will house both retail and office spaces, aiming to create substantial non-fare revenue for the metro operation. Is traffic and parking management the key to making this venture a success? Experts weigh in as CMRL strives to maximize its land asset monetization.

news.title: Hubballi-Dharwad civic body plans permanent UID for every property
news.para: The Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation is set to launch a revolutionary 16-digit Unique Identification system for properties, which will provide a stable alternative to the frequently changing Property Identification system. This innovative UID will streamline various civic services and fee collection processes, aiming to make Hubballi-Dharwad the second city in South India to implement such a comprehensive system.

news.title: Bombay HC clears construction on two Pune Cantonment leasehold plots
news.para: The Bombay High Court has permitted residential building on leasehold plots in Pune Cantonment, mandating that defence authorities grant construction permits within a month. The ruling emphasizes that future defence requirements cannot compromise the rights of current leaseholders. These leases remain in effect until 2033, but renewals are uncertain. Meanwhile, defence authorities are considering legal avenues to contest this decision.
